name: What types of roof framing systems are available, and how do I choose the best one for my project?

mainEntity.name: What types of roof framing systems are available, and how do I choose the best one for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common roof framing systems include stick framing, where individual lumber pieces are cut and assembled on-site, and truss framing, which uses pre-fabricated triangular units. The best system for your project depends on several factors, such as the roof's span, desired ceiling aesthetics (e.g., vaulted ceilings require different approaches), budget, and project timeline. Stick framing often offers more flexibility for custom designs and attic space, while trusses can be more cost-effective and quicker to install for standard designs. During the design phase, AKN Design Group will guide you through these options, discussing the practical tradeoffs and helping you select a system that aligns with your architectural vision and functional requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common roof framing systems are stick framing and truss framing; the best choice depends on span, aesthetics, budget, and timeline, which we'll help you evaluate.
